findings.title: Inherited wealth becomes hoarded mass
findings.claim: The inherited estate is read as wealth seized wholesale and added to an already attached, abundant mass, so the transfer from former holder to recipient becomes predatory hoarding.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb and inheritance noun carry the ordinary taking relation; the 89:20 attachment, wealth, and abundance images meet those two focus carriers and turn the act into an inward expansion of the possessed mass.
findings.reader_payoff: The charge becomes more than a private act of taking: the reader can see inherited property entering a self-enlarging stock that the surrounding rebuke exposes as social failure.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains consuming the inheritance. The abundance and attachment images describe the supplied pericope relation, not a literal equation of inheritance with every form of wealth or a claim that the focus has lost its ordinary legal sense.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch records are accepted and the channel source is trusted, while the cross-ayah image remains a reviewed nomination rather than an independent lexical proof for every context form.

findings.title: Consumption as fed and rekindled fire
findings.claim: The focus act can be pictured as a fire relation: inheritance supplies material to be consumed, the adjoining attachment supplies sparks, and the later burial image supplies concealment and the possibility of rekindling.
findings.mechanism: The focus eating and inheritance carriers meet the supplied fire-consumption and ember-stirring facets; 89:20 supplies the spark image and 89:21 supplies covering with soil, so intake becomes a process that can consume, conceal, and flare again.
findings.reader_payoff: The repeated intensity of the wording becomes visible as a process rather than a bare synonym: what is taken can feed an appetite, disappear under it, and remain capable of being stirred back into flame.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains the comprehensive consumption of inheritance. Sparks, embers, and burial are a contextual material analogy; the focus is not translated as literal fire and no anger or sword facet is added.

epistemic.reason: The focus fire and inheritance facets and the channel's four anchored source images are supplied, but the fire process is a channel-informed contextual synthesis rather than a direct surface gloss.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is explicit and strong, while the branch images for 89:20 are supplied in the packet with trusted channel provenance; legacy-unbound context keeps the causal loop qualified.
